links.comparator_used: Standard reading-level prompt with no grade-level instruction
links.outcome: Understandability (share of texts with PEMAT-P score ≥70)
links.effect: At standard level, 46.7% of ChatGPT-4o texts and 78.6% of Gemini texts achieved PEMAT-P ≥70; at the 6th-grade level, all AI-generated texts exceeded this threshold.
links.tradeoff: Both AI and web content lacked sufficient actionable elements and visual support. Accuracy and reliability of the AI text were not assessed. Copilot showed limitations in coherence and clarity.
links.quote: At the 6th-grade level, all AI-generated texts exceeded this threshold.
